hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: Discover the history of TrailForge and our passion for outdoor adventures

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: At TrailForge, we believe that nature is one of life's greatest gifts. Our mission is to connect adventurers, hikers, cyclists, and runners with the most beautiful and challenging routes in our country.
mission.p2: We want to make exploring new routes easy, safe, and accessible for everyone, from beginners to experienced athletes.

passion.title: Passion
passion.desc: We are passionate about nature and want to share that passion with you

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.desc: Truthful information, verified routes, and honest reviews from our users

community.title: Community
community.desc: We build a community where adventurers connect and share experiences

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.desc: We use technology to continuously improve our users' experience

team.title: Our Team
team.intro: We are a diverse team of developers, designers, and nature enthusiasts. Each of us brings our outdoor sports experience to create the best routing platform in the country.

maria.desc: Experienced mountaineer and nature lover. Directs the vision of TrailForge.

carlos.desc: Software engineer specializing in mobile and web applications.

ana.desc: UX/UI designer with a passion for creating intuitive and beautiful experiences.

partners.title: Collaborating Companies
partners.intro: At TrailForge we work with the best professionals to offer you quality services on your adventures.

harman.desc: Specialists in MTB and road cycling. They offer top quality rental and maintenance.

summit.desc: Expert local guides to explore the mountains with total safety and learn about the environment.

partners.ferratas: Both companies collaborate closely to offer equipment and expert guiding on the best Via Ferratas in the region.
